// CASE dart_honest expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}
// CASE dart_take_one expect=fire
class A {
  Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
    List<T> items,
    int width,
    Future<R> Function(T) operation,
  ) async {
    final results = <R>[];
    for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += 1) {
      final group = items.skip(offset).take(1);
      results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
    }
    return results;
  }
}
// CASE dart_extra_await expect=fire
class B {
  Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
    List<T> items,
    int width,
    Future<R> Function(T) operation,
  ) async {
    final results = <R>[];
    for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
      final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
      results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
      await flush(offset);
    }
    return results;
  }
}
// CASE end expect=pass
